[00:29] Elon Musk Pitches Precursor (先驱；雏形；前身) (先驱；前身；雏形。) Hyperloop to Link Austin and San Antonio. Elon Musk announced that his company is designing a simple precursor Hyperloop to connect Austin and San Antonio. The Boring Company claims the underground transport (运输；客运系统。) system could cut the travel time between the two Texas cities to less than thirty minutes. Although the startup has faced criticism for failing to deliver past projects in Chicago and Los Angeles, it continues to operate a shuttle (穿梭班车；往返短途运输。) network in Las Vegas. The venture (初创企业；商业探索项目。) also recently raised three billion dollars to fund its engineering ambitions. Transportation analysts say that building high-speed regional links requires massive capital, extensive regulatory (监管的；法规的。) approvals, and proven tunnel safety before passengers can ride. (Source: TechCrunch)
马斯克旗下隧道公司计划在奥斯汀与圣安东尼奥之间建设超级高铁雏形。埃隆·马斯克宣布，他的公司正在设计一个连接奥斯汀和圣安东尼奥的简易超级高铁雏形。The Boring Company 宣称，这套地下交通系统能将这两座德克萨斯州城市之间的通行时间缩短至 30 分钟以内。尽管该初创公司曾因未能落实芝加哥和洛杉矶等地的早期项目而遭遇质疑，但它目前仍在拉斯维加斯运营一套穿梭接驳网络。这家企业近期还筹集了 30 亿美元资金以支持其工程建设雄心。交通领域分析师表示，建设区域高速交通网络需要巨额资本、繁复的监管审批以及经过充分验证的隧道安全保障，才能最终投入载客运营。（来源：TechCrunch）

[01:21] Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Dismisses Existential AI Threats and Regulatory Calls. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang recently dismissed concerns about extreme risks from artificial intelligence, stating there is zero chance AI will end human civilization (文明；人类社会。). In a television interview, Huang argued that spreading alarm about catastrophic (灾难性的；毁灭性的。) outcomes is unnecessary and irresponsible. He also questioned calls from other tech leaders to pause or slow down model development, claiming such warnings lack scientific (科学的；符合科学依据的。) basis. In addition, Huang expressed strong opposition to strict new government regulations that could limit technological innovation (创新；技术革新。). Critics observed that Huang leads the primary supplier of computing hardware powering the AI boom, giving his company a strong commercial motive (动机；原动力。) to favor continuous rapid expansion. (Source: The Verge Tech & Culture)
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋驳斥AI灭绝威胁论，反对过度监管。英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋近日驳斥了关于人工智能极端风险的担忧，称 AI 毁灭人类文明的概率为零。在一次电视采访中，黄仁勋认为散布灾难性后果的恐慌既无必要也不负责任。他还质疑了其他科技领袖关于暂停或放缓模型研发的呼吁，声称此类警告缺乏科学依据。此外，黄仁勋对可能限制技术创新的严格政府新规表示强烈反对。批评人士指出，黄仁勋掌管着推动 AI 热潮的核心算力硬件供应龙头，这使得他的公司拥有强烈的商业动机去支持持续快速的技术扩张。（来源：The Verge Tech & Culture）

[02:08] Tencent Unveils Gander AI Model for Simultaneous Dialogue and Agent Execution. Tencent researchers have introduced Gander, an artificial intelligence model capable of holding a continuous (连续的；持续不断的。) voice conversation while working on complex tasks in the background. Traditional voice assistants require users to take turns speaking, but Gander supports full-duplex communication so people can interrupt at any moment. To achieve this, the architecture (架构；体系结构。) separates conversation timing from heavy reasoning by using two specialized (专门的；特化的。) roles named the cerebellum (小脑；（系统中负责时序调度的）控制模块。) and the brain. The fast cerebellum manages real-time audio interaction, while the background brain performs detailed planning and executes agent tools. Benchmark results show that Gander handles conversational interruptions with great precision (精准度；精确性。), although complex perceptual tasks still show trade-offs between response speed and overall accuracy. (Source: The Decoder)
腾讯推出 Gander AI 模型：支持边实时对话边在后台执行智能体任务。腾讯研究团队发布了 Gander，这是一款能够在后台处理复杂任务的同时保持连续语音对话的人工智能模型。传统的语音助手要求用户轮流发言，但 Gander 支持全双工通信，使用户可以随时打断。为了实现这一目标，该架构将对话时序管理与重度推理计算分离开来，采用了名为“小脑”和“大脑”的两个专门角色。敏捷的小脑负责管理实时音频交互，而后台大脑则执行细致的规划并调用智能体工具。基准测试结果显示，Gander 能够极为精准地处理对话打断，尽管复杂的感知任务在响应速度与整体准确性之间仍存在一定取舍。（来源：The Decoder）
